units: Gen. R. s. 76 (expl. קטנתי, Gen. XXXII, 11) איני כדאי … כדאי אני אכל קָטֹנְתִּי מכל וכ׳ I am not deserving (of any of the mercies &c.); R. L. says, I am deserving, but I am too small for (unworthy of) all the mercies &c.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 90b:4">B. Bath. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>מַקְטִינֵי איפה</he> those who make the Ephah (measure) small (<cite ref="Amos 8:5">Am. VIII, 5</cite>). Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵇ Samuel was surnamed ‘the small’, <he>לפי שהוא מַקְטִין את עצמו</he> because he made himself small (bore himself humbly).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37:7">Gen. R. s. 37</cite> (play on <he>יקטן</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 10:25">Gen. X, 25</cite>) <he>מקטין את עסקיו</he> made his affairs small (was contented with subordinate services); <he>מקטין את עצמו ואת עסקיו</he> subordinated himself and his affairs, v. <cite ref="R00661"><he>צָעַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 31:7">Lev. R. s. 31</cite> <he>מַקְטִינוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="T00473"><he>רָחב</he></cite>; Pesik. Ḳumi, p. 145ᵃ; ib. 145ᵇ <he>מקיטנות</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:5">Tosef. Sot. XV, 5</cite> Var. <he>משמת … נִתְקַטְּנָה חסידות וכ׳</he> when Abba José ben Ḳiṭnith died, piety became rare in Israel; v. <cite ref="S00900"><he>קִיטּוּנְתָּא</he></cite>.
